authority: Offline source/lifetime assessment and attribution of an existing real-API diagnostic. No new GPU execution or measured candidate.
product_constraint: Exact MTP at configured caps 2/3, matched Decode gain 50%-200%, with joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting.
question: Does direct canonical publication of the first multirow prefix justify a standalone implementation or reopening v126?

mechanism.first_prefix_is_mandatory: After successful verification run_round commits prefix1 before its first observer, including mismatch/EOS/cancellation. Failure before publication aborts and poisons.
mechanism.selection_is_monotonic: commit_prefix requires rows == committed_ + 1. No earlier prefix can be reselected by this controller.
mechanism.gdn_route: Both enqueue_gdn_block and the non-graph path currently read canonical state for row0 and write immutable slot1; later rows consume prior slots.
mechanism.conv_obligation: Conv is updated in canonical storage for every speculative row. Direct GDN row0 alone does not leave the complete first-prefix canonical state; Conv restoration remains necessary.
mechanism.hidden_logits_obligation: Verifier scratch is reused across layers and vocabulary finalization. Full prefix hidden/logits remain in separate immutable slots and must be published.
mechanism.lifetime_obligation: Aliasing slot1 GDN with canonical storage makes commit2 overwrite it. Current MTP contract promises immutable slots until retirement. A future owner-based design must explicitly replace that lifetime contract, prove all consumers and preserve complete state before every observer.
mechanism.unchanged_work: No projection, draft, verified row, acceptance or later-prefix publication is removed. Singleton copying is a separate closed lineage.

historical_profile_attribution.version: v113; same relevant source and six-M3/one-M1 work topology, not a new v122 or v126 profile
historical_profile_attribution.interpretation: First complete recurrent copy after each complete verifier Graph. This includes Conv, so is broader than GDN-only elision. Excludes CPU synchronization and other commit work; no hardware or unprofiled latency bound.

v126_context.status: Already closed below its API floor and removed. Historical copy attribution does not prove additive speedup or justify reopening this composition.

decision: Do not implement first-prefix-only relocation or revive startup-input plus first-prefix-only as the next full-budget candidate. The identified copy opportunity is too small to support that planning hypothesis, and it requires a state-lifetime redesign. This is a scoped engineering-priority decision, not an impossibility claim.
next_action: Assess complete recurrent-state ownership/publication, including every committed prefix and all scalar/observer/reset consumers, before selecting any owner-based composition. If a physical canonical arena is unavoidable, return to dominant projection/draft computation. No new runtime package is selected by this assessment.
validation: Read-only SQLite attribution, exact source hashes against retained budget, six unique Graph/first-copy correlations, current API budget arithmetic. No synthetic timing or new performance result.
